question_results.summary: C_REQ_ON remains positively source-supported but is excluded because K_REQ_MODE_ONE_OF leaves only C_REQ_SAFE and grounded K_REQ_ON_REQUIRES_FAST therefore cannot satisfy its C_REQ_FAST consequent.
evidence: REQUIRES_EXPLAIN_JSON reports support supported, viability excluded, effective scope V_REQ_TRIGGER,V_REQ_MODE, and the ordered RCG-RSN-201/203/206 chain.
RCG-RSN-203 names antecedent C_REQ_ON, consequent C_REQ_FAST, and K_REQ_ON_REQUIRES_FAST; the result does not select the missing consequent or reverse the implication.

question_results.summary: The run proves equality across different candidate IDs and preserves an open operand as unknown, but protocol v5 has no command case that can expose the required RCG-RSN-204 evidence for a known typed mismatch.
evidence: SAME_AS_EXPLAIN_JSON reports an allowed witness pairing C_SAME_LEFT_RED and C_SAME_RIGHT_RED, whose distinct IDs carry the same symbol value red.
OPEN_RELATIONAL_EXPLAIN_JSON reports viability and variable resolution unknown with RCG-RSN-001 and no derivations, but no bound v5 execution targets C_SAME_RIGHT_BLUE to expose RCG-RSN-204.

question_results.summary: The two known symbol red assignments violate grounded K_VALUES_DISTINCT and exclude C_DISTINCT_LEFT_RED through a deterministic RCG-RSN-201/205/206 chain.
evidence: DISTINCT_FROM_EXPLAIN_JSON reports C_DISTINCT_LEFT_RED and C_DISTINCT_RIGHT_RED as the RCG-RSN-205 inputs with K_VALUES_DISTINCT.

The result retains all three effective constraint IDs, explicit grounding through S_SEM_RELATIONAL and S_ADR_ASSIGNMENTS, and an inconsistent variable resolution without treating absence of same_as as evidence.

question_results.summary: The allowed C_NAV_SAFE target proves only the C_NAV_OFF plus C_NAV_SAFE witness; it does not expose the blocked C_NAV_ON plus C_NAV_SAFE alternative, so target-specific explain alone does not answer the compound navigation question.
evidence: COMPOUND_TARGET_EXPLAIN_JSON reports viability allowed, RCG-RSN-101, all three relevant constraints, and the joint C_NAV_OFF plus C_NAV_SAFE witness in both byte-identical repetitions.

No RCG-RSN-203 for the blocked C_NAV_ON branch is projected; the responsibility-preserving candidate is the later bounded read-only query slice or explicit multi-target navigation, not widening every allowed-candidate reason chain.

question_results.summary: Each allowed relational candidate inspected by the protocol has one complete joint witness over its effective solver scope rather than a combination of individually viable values.
evidence: SAME_AS_EXPLAIN_JSON reports V_SAME_LEFT=C_SAME_LEFT_RED and V_SAME_RIGHT=C_SAME_RIGHT_RED with K_SAME_LEFT_ONE_OF, K_SAME_RIGHT_ONE_OF, and K_VALUES_SAME relevant.

COMPOUND_TARGET_EXPLAIN_JSON reports V_NAV_STATE=C_NAV_OFF and V_NAV_MODE=C_NAV_SAFE with K_NAV_STATE_ONE_OF, K_NAV_MODE_ONE_OF, and K_NAV_ON_REQUIRES_FAST relevant; both results are complete and non-truncated.

observations.summary: Protocol v5 requires RCG-RSN-204 evidence for DGF-CORE-002 but its bound command cases cannot target the known mismatching candidate while also retaining the required scope binding.
observations.evidence: SAME_AS_EXPLAIN_JSON is bound to --scope V_SAME_LEFT and was used to prove the equal-red witness, while C_SAME_RIGHT_BLUE requires V_SAME_RIGHT in the requested scope; no other relational_constraints_v5 command case obtains the known-mismatch reason.
reproduction_steps: Run SAME_AS_EXPLAIN_JSON exactly as bound in this receipt and observe the allowed red/red witness with only RCG-RSN-101.
Run OPEN_RELATIONAL_EXPLAIN_JSON and observe RCG-RSN-001 without RCG-RSN-204.
Compare the available relational_constraints_v5 command cases with DGF-CORE-002 required_evidence.
observations.proposed_action: Create a new immutable protocol version with a repeated known-mismatch explain case using the complete required scope, then rerun the relational round under a new run ID before marking the dogfood task done.

observations.summary: The compound allowed C_NAV_SAFE explanation still omits the blocked C_NAV_ON alternative, confirming that one target-specific result cannot answer the allowed-plus-forbidden navigation question.
observations.evidence: COMPOUND_TARGET_EXPLAIN_JSON includes K_NAV_ON_REQUIRES_FAST as relevant and proves C_NAV_OFF plus C_NAV_SAFE through RCG-RSN-101, but it has no RCG-RSN-203 derivation for C_NAV_ON plus C_NAV_SAFE.
reproduction_steps: Inspect the complete joint witness and relevant_constraint_ids.
Observe that the blocked alternative is not present in derivations despite the requires constraint being relevant.
observations.proposed_action: Use the already reserved feedback point to decide whether the next bounded query result supplies composed navigation, explicit target links are needed, or target factoring remains acceptable; do not widen ExplainResult v2 without an ADR.

observations.summary: The internal receipt schema had not been extended beyond protocol v3, so a protocol-v5 receipt could not be validated until its closed round and protocol-path enums were updated.
observations.evidence: Before this run was recorded, Llmrecog.Internal.DogfoodRunReceipt.v1 accepted only grammar_authoring_v1 through exclusion_explain_v3 and protocol-v1 through protocol-v3.

Attempt to validate a receipt bound to relational_constraints_v5 and dogfood/protocol-v5/protocol.json.
Observe the round_id and protocol.path enum failures.
